Headline results of run /home/hyoklee/poro/agent/results/run_20261115T155359Z_s20 (read-only report; no PBS jobs submitted, hazard.py not run):

DATA COVERAGE
- Records analysed: 759 (stride 20), spanning 2016-03-18T02:09:17Z to 2016-03-26T00:59:44Z (~3.314% of the March 2016 time window).
- Anomalous records (|robust z| > 5): 57.
- DAS detections: 62 detections in 53 records; relative b = 0.9849 (34 above Mc).
- Pumping: injected 4.654e+05 m3, extracted 5.059e+05 m3, net -4.048e+04 m3 over 15.96 days (net extraction).
- Catalogue: 5 events, ML -0.48 to 0.07 (GDR 859, LBNL/NCEDC March 2016).

CALIBRATED PROBABILITIES (catalogue-based, Shapiro et al. 2021 Eq. 5 — this is the calibrated estimate, using the LBNL/NCEDC catalogue magnitudes):
- b = 1.0: Sigma = -5.449, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.0001198 (1.198e-4), P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 5.236e-06, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.03719.
- b = 0.73: Sigma = -5.319, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.004922, P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0002155, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.2809.
- b = 0.65: Sigma = -5.281, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.01474, P(Mw>=5.5) over observed volume = 0.0006484, P(M>=3)/yr = 0.4653.

DAS-BASED UPPER BOUND (uncalibrated DAS magnitudes; every DAS detection counted as an event at/above the catalogue Mc, so it over-counts — this is the upper bound, NOT calibrated):
- b = 0.9849: Sigma = -2.698, P(Mw>=5.5)/yr = 0.07842.

INTERPRETATION: The calibrated catalogue-based annual probability of a Pohang-like Mw>=5.5 event is at most ~1.5e-2/yr (b=0.65 scenario) and as low as ~1.2e-4/yr (b=1.0), while the DAS-only upper bound is 0.07842/yr because uncalibrated DAS magnitudes over-count events. The DAS anomaly/detection counts (57 anomalous records, 62 detections in 53 records) indicate injection-period strain anomalies in the PoroTomo DAS data, but the calibrated seismicity rates do not support a high likelihood of an Mw>=5.5 induced earthquake at Brady Hot Springs during March 2016.
